class.name: BehaviorTreeTask
class.brief_description: Base resource for AI behavior tree tasks.
class.description: Subclass this resource in GDScript and implement [method _tick] to create custom conditions and actions. Return [constant SUCCESS], [constant FAILURE], or [constant RUNNING]. A [BehaviorTreeRunner] supplies a shared per-agent [Dictionary] blackboard and [code]delta[/code] time. Built-in task resources can be assembled without scripts. A task resource must not store agent-specific execution cursors: it may be shared by multiple runners.

method.name: _tick
method.description: Returns the current execution status for the task. Implement this method in a GDScript subclass. Modify [param blackboard] to share state with other tasks in the same agent.
